note:
The growth suite. Four briefs a real owner would give, run through the same profile the onboarding interview fills.

Every check here is about the gate holding and the copy being lawful and specific. The one that matters most is the simplest: after a drafting task, **nothing has been executed**. If that ever fails, the phase has failed regardless of how good the posts are.

Copy quality beyond the mechanical rules is not asserted. Whether a post is worth reading is a judgement, and a script claiming to make it would be the kind of eval that stops meaning anything.
